name: Motaire De Platine
original_name: モテール・ド・プラティーヌ
source:
Lute's classmate in the Knight Academy. He is an Elite Royal Knight and top first in rank after graduating in Knight Academy along with Lute. He has immense pride and hates Lute as he's ashamed to be in class together with him.

モテール (moteeru) =>  モテる (moteru) => to be popular
